saw_lines: Premium meat buyers decide on trust in seconds, looking for how the animal was raised.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the raising story lands or gets scrolled past.
Your 14 sampled ads open on 9 different lines, and none carry a proof number. Put one farm number in every opening line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 10 Oct 2026
points: The same pasture-raised first line opens 5 ads, so they fight for the same buyers. Test three new openers this week.
The offer lands after 55% of the median ad’s copy. Move it into the first two lines.
None of 14 sampled ads carry a proof number, so buyers only get claims. Add one herd number to every ad.
All 14 sampled ads are video and none use claim words, so the format is working. Double down with more video.

ads_1: Farm-to-table video that opens on a dinner problem, not the pasture line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Twitter
